title: List of spaces
content: Combination of all schools, multiple stories and difficult to navigate. Gigantic mall with multiple stories. Stairwells that are white and orange tiles. Basement area which is dark and scary. A roller coaster goes through parts of the mall. Fountains, some empty and some full. Broken sky lights. People walk around like normal, but you can also rent roller blades to get around faster. One side of the mall has a movie theater facing the parking lot. On the opposite side of the mall is a huge dollar store. In the center of the mall is an abandoned fish store with gigantic tanks and very scary, large fish. A pet shop with animals that are too populated. A hat shop that seems shady next to a fye type shop. A very normal, nice jc penny's where you can call for help. A very large mansion with a pool on the back, built up in a way that overlooks the countryside below with haybales. Inside, a wrap around second story balcony that overlooks a room below full of fancy furniture. Rattlesnakes are everywhere down there, and there is a wardrobe with live snakes for handles. On the second story on the far side of the balcony is a door that leads to a call center type space with an office in the back. The room is full of mannequins wearing elaborate clothes. Forest mountain Town. Wooden cabins used to be miner housing. River runs from a canyon. Go up through the mountains along the river far enough and you'll wake up. A woman lives in town next to a bakery with a large friendly dog. You will get stuck if you try to go up the hillside with the pine trees. A costal town, maybe on a lake, with a long row of attached cabanas you can rent. Outdated like 80s style. You may buy a house that used to be a boat. It's 5 or more stories. You try to renovate it but scary or bad things happen. A sky all airport with hotels. Such a tall building you can't see the bottom or the top. Awesome kitchen/grocery store with chefs and lots of snacks.
